policy_title: Deliver 1.6 Million Homes and Support First-Time Buyers
stated: The Conservative Party commits to delivering 1.6 million homes in England by abolishing legacy EU 'nutrient neutrality' rules, fast-tracking homes on urban brownfield land, raising density in inner London, and creating urban development corporations. They will also make Stamp Duty permanent for first-time buyers up to £425,000 and launch a new Help to Buy scheme.

source.quote: Deliver 1.6 million well-designed homes in the right places while protecting our countryside, permanently abolish Stamp Duty for homes up to £425,000 for first time buyers and introduce a new Help to Buy scheme. ...Abolishing the legacy EU ‘nutrient neutrality’ rules to immediately unlock the building of 100,000 new homes...

bearing_set.reason: The policy directly targets housing supply (1.6m homes target via brownfield fast-tracking, density uplift, urban development corporations) and first-time buyer affordability (permanent Stamp Duty relief, new Help to Buy), earning a real verdict on supply adequacy, affordability, and tenure mix.

Abolishing 'nutrient neutrality' rules removes protections requiring developers to offset nitrogen/phosphorus pollution in protected waterways, plausibly worsening water quality in affected catchment areas — a real, non-negligible verdict on a core O6 indicator.

Making the elevated Stamp Duty threshold (£425k) permanent for first-time buyers is a direct tax reduction that increases take-home wealth on purchase; a real, non-negligible O11 'improves' for that cohort.

The permanent Stamp Duty relief forgoes ongoing SDLT revenue, and a new Help to Buy scheme involves government guarantees/contingent liabilities — together these are a material, ongoing fiscal commitment that moves the funded-vs-borrowed balance.

Large-scale housebuilding at 1.6 m homes would meaningfully improve labour-market mobility (workers can relocate to high-productivity areas), a well-evidenced mechanism linking housing supply constraints to aggregate productivity and living-standards loss.

membership_note: Five fundamentals: the housing and first-time-buyer package drives O1 (core target); nutrient neutrality abolition earns a genuine O6 verdict via a specific environmental mechanism; the Stamp Duty change earns separate O11 and O12 verdicts (lower tax burden vs. revenue forgone); and supply at this scale earns an O13 verdict via the labour-mobility/productivity channel.
